question: How do the fourfold and fivefold divisions of consciousness arise?
premises: With the assistance of the unfolding power consciousness is also spoken of as fourfold
Through ascent in the bliss of the power of consciousness it is declared fivefold
These are further articulations of the same consciousness
inference: The fourfold and fivefold forms arise from the same consciousness through unfolding and blissful ascent.
plain_english: Then, through the assistance of the unfolding power, it is also spoken of as fourfold; and through ascent in the bliss of the power of consciousness, this same consciousness is declared to be fivefold.
